title: Count Divisible Numbers
description: Read two integers n and k, then read a list of n integers. Count how many numbers in the list are divisible by k, using a loop and an accumulator. A number x is divisible by k when x % k == 0. This problem tests loop bounds and iteration control (C3): the loop must visit every element exactly once and the running count must start at zero. Implement your solution in Java inside the provided Main class; read from standard input and print the answer to standard output.
constraints: Each of the n list values satisfies -1000000000 <= value <= 1000000000
input_format: First line: two integers n and k separated by a space. Second line: n integers separated by spaces.
output_format: A single integer: how many of the n numbers are divisible by k.
